The '''29th Fast Attack Squadron''' was a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] that was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A contingent of the 29th was part of a mixed [[Mephitis starfighter squadron|starfighter squadron]] along with [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] from the [[92nd Interceptor Squadron]] and was stationed aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Mephitis (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Mephitis'']] while it conducted tests of the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph Phantom stealth starfighter]] near [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].<ref name="Phantoms" />
